name: Cenarius
summary: Across Kalimdor, Cenarius guards the wild places and teaches the night elves druidism. The ancient demigod, son of Elune and Malorne, guided mortal druids for thousands of years before falling in battle during the Third War.

sections.title: Son of Heaven and Earth
sections.body: Born to Elune, goddess of the moon, and Malorne, the great white stag demigod, Cenarius was bound to the mortal world and placed in Malorne's care. Ysera the Dreamer took him as a foster son and guided him along the infinite paths of the Emerald Dream. Cenarius held power over living wood and earth. He fathered the Keepers of the Grove and the dryads, binding his bloodline to Kalimdor's wild places.

sections.title: The First Druid
sections.body: Millennia ago, Malfurion Stormrage, his twin Illidan, and Tyrande Whisperwind sought the legendary demigod. Cenarius saw Malfurion's exceptional heart and trained him as the first mortal druid. When Queen Azshara and her Highborne unleashed the Burning Legion in the War of the Ancients, Cenarius gathered Kalimdor's wild demigods to fight beside the mortal defenders.

sections.title: The Fall at Ashenvale
sections.body:
For ten thousand years after the Great Sundering, Cenarius watched over Kalimdor and nurtured the Cenarion Circle with Malfurion. During the Third War, the Warsong clan began cutting timber in Ashenvale. Angered by the ruin of sacred woodlands, Cenarius drove the invaders back.

Then Grom Hellscream and his warriors took Mannoroth's demonic blood. Filled with demonic fury, the corrupted orcs overwhelmed Cenarius and struck him down. Nature's defenders were left in deep sorrow.

faq.answer: Cenarius is the ancient demigod who guarded Azeroth's wilderness and guided druids. Elune, goddess of the moon, and Malorne, the demigod, were his parents; Ysera fostered him.
Cenarius fathered the Keepers of the Grove, including Keeper Remulos and Ordanus, and the dryads. The centaur trace their lineage to his son Zaetar, making Cenarius their grandfather.

faq.q: How did Malfurion learn druidism from Cenarius?
faq.answer: Before the War of the Ancients, Malfurion sought Cenarius with Illidan and Tyrande. Cenarius recognized Malfurion's rare dedication and balance, then taught him the arts of nature and made him the first mortal druid.

faq.q: What happened to Cenarius in the Third War?
faq.answer: During the Third War, the Warsong clan cut timber in Ashenvale, drawing Cenarius's wrath. Grom Hellscream drank from a pool tainted by Mannoroth's blood, gained demonic strength, and slew the demigod.

faq.q: What is Cenarius's connection to the tauren?
faq.answer: Tauren druids follow the path Cenarius taught Malfurion Stormrage. Through Hamuul Runetotem's place in the Cenarion Circle, the tauren study Cenarius's ways alongside the night elves.
The Cenarion Circle is an order of druids devoted to preserving nature's balance, studying the Emerald Dream, and guarding sacred forests. Malfurion Stormrage founded it in Cenarius's honor.

angles.text: As a druid, your path traces back to Cenarius. His lessons to Malfurion established the druidic ways.
As a night elf, you revere Cenarius as a divine guide and ally. His death at the hands of the Warsong orcs remains an unforgiven tragedy.
As a tauren, you honor Cenarius's teachings and walk his path alongside the night elves of the Cenarion Circle.
As an orc, Cenarius's slaying by Grom Hellscream recalls the blood curse and the cost of demonic servitude.
